optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Delivery Project Coordinator, Retail Store Operations

professionalSummary.text: Experienced Delivery Project Coordinator with demonstrated success in managing end-to-end rollout of point-of-sale systems across 26-store waves in retail operations.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated the schedule for wave 3 of the point-of-sale rollout (26 stores) in the programme planning tool, keeping the readiness tracker current and re-sequencing store visits when field engineers were reassigned.

experienceHighlights.text: Owned end-to-end rollout plan for wave 3 (26 stores), including scheduling, readiness sign-off, and delivery accountability.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated the schedule for wave 3 of the point-of-sale rollout (26 stores) in the programme planning tool, keeping the readiness tracker current and re-sequencing store visits when field engineers were reassigned.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained store-readiness tracker and field-engineer schedule in programme planning tool, re-sequencing visits when engineers were reassigned.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated the schedule for wave 3 of the point-of-sale rollout (26 stores) in the programme planning tool, keeping the readiness tracker current and re-sequencing store visits when field engineers were reassigned.

experienceHighlights.text: Ran weekly readiness calls with regional operations and IT field services, preparing agendas, minutes, and following up on open items.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the agenda and minutes for the weekly readiness call with regional operations and IT field services, and followed up on the open items list between calls.

experienceHighlights.text: Escalated scheduling and stock blockers to programme lead with recommended solutions, documenting decisions made by programme lead and regional operations manager.
experienceHighlights.witness: Raised scheduling and stock blockers to the programme lead with a suggested option; decisions on store priority and any date changes were taken by the programme lead, and readiness sign-off for each store was given by the regional operations manager.

experienceHighlights.text: Produced wave 3 close-out report with lessons learned and hand-over checklist for store support, using tracker and call minutes as sources.
experienceHighlights.witness: Drafted the wave 3 close-out report from the tracker and the call minutes, including lessons learned on shelf-label stock and the hand-over checklist for store support.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Wave 3 point-of-sale rollout (26 stores): maintained readiness tracker, managed engineer schedule, ran weekly calls, escalated blockers, and produced close-out report.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the wave 3 readiness tracker export (store, visit date, engineer, readiness status, sign-off name, open items) and the close-out report draft with tracked changes from the programme lead.

skills.text: Programme planning tool proficiency, readiness tracker maintenance, meeting coordination, blocker escalation, close-out reporting.
skills.witness: Responsibilities included tracker maintenance, meeting coordination, blocker escalation and close-out documentation as a member of the programme office during the wave 3 rollout.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience with wave 3 of a point-of-sale rollout (26 stores), including specific responsibilities related to the job requirements. The materials do not establish experience with multiple waves or larger-scale rollouts beyond wave 3.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required due to partial evidence on blocker escalation and lack of evidence for multiple wave experience.
